proposition: Melvin-Koushki's Timeline A.1 rests mostly on the colophons of MS Majlis 10196, the Munshaʾāt-i Turka and the Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī, with some dates and events conjectured or approximate; external political events are taken from Manz; it does not say entry by entry which source a date rests on.
